subject: Re: ACME pilot — SLA structure, credits, and retainer options
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ACME pilot — initial SLA ask

Hi Vivek / Karthik,

Thanks for the product demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency profile. Procurement asked me to get a written proposal for SLA and premium support options for our 6-month pilot. Top asks from our side:

- Target uptime for the pilot region (us-east) — looking for 99.99% but open to negotiation if there are compensating credits.
- Faster incident response for production P1s (15 minute acknowledgement + 1 hour remediation window).
- Clear escalation path (engineering on-call + dedicated CSM for the pilot window).
- Pricing cap — our budget for support is $X/month (will share offline).

Could you send a short matrix with 2–3 support tiers + what credits look like at 99.9 / 99.95 / 99.99? Also include any retainer / on-call pricing and whether there are discounts for a 12-month commit.

Attaching a short RFQ (Acme_Request_for_SLA.docx). We’d like to lock terms quickly if numbers work.

Best,
Maria
Principal Product Ops | Acme.ai

Attachment: Acme_Request_for_SLA.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME pilot — initial SLA ask

Maria — thanks for the clear asks and the RFQ. I’ve put together a concise proposal that maps three support tiers to uptime bands, response windows, and credit behavior. High level summary below; full proposal attached.

Summary (high level):
- Standard: 99.9% uptime, P1 acknowledge <30 mins, 8x5 business hours; 5% monthly credit at 99.0-99.89, 10% below 99.0.
- Enhanced: 99.95% uptime, P1 acknowledge <15 mins, 24x7 on-call; 10% monthly credit at 99.0-99.94, 20% below 99.0.
- Premium (recommended for low-latency use-cases): 99.99% uptime, P1 acknowledge <15 mins, 24x7 on-call + named CSM + up to 2 on-call rotation overrides; 20% monthly credit at 99.0-99.98, 40% below 99.0.

Retainer options: 24/7 on-call retainer (flat monthly), or ad-hoc incident engineering hours ($/hour). We offer a sliding discount up to 12% for 12-month commit (applies to support retainer, not per-token usage).

I’m attaching Redwood_Premium_SLA_Proposal_v1.pdf — it includes pricing bands for US and EU regions, escalation contacts, and a sample MAP. If useful, I can convert this into a DocuSign-ready SOW.

Next steps: if you’re comfortable with the premium tier framing, we’ll draft a short MAP and route to legal. Happy to hop on a follow-up to walk the table.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Premium_SLA_Proposal_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-02T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: internal: ACME pilot — pricing levers

Quick internal note —

Vivek / Laura,

I reviewed the numbers on v1. Acme’s budget is tight; they’ll likely push hard on retainer size. Two levers we can use without escalation: 1) offer a 6-month step-down on the retainer (start higher first two months), 2) include a one-time onboarding credit to offset perceived risk.

If they insist on 99.99 for the pilot, we should ask for either a slightly higher retainer or a 12-month commit in exchange for >8% discount. Laura — can we get signoff to commit to a 10% discount for a 12-month commit?

Karthik

[No external recipients on this internal thread]

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-03T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Updated proposal and MAP link — ACME pilot

Maria — attaching v2 with two concrete packages tailored to the pilot. Highlights:

- Pilot Premium Lite (recommended): 99.95% uptime for pilot region (us-east) + 24x7 P1 acknowledgement <15m, named CSM during pilot, $6k/month retainer. Credits: 10% monthly credit slab for 99.0–99.94, 25% below 99.0. 10% discount for 12-month commit.
- Pilot Premium Full: 99.99% uptime guarantee (applies to control-plane + inference) + full on-call rotations and 2-hour remediation SLAs for P1s, $12k/month retainer. Credits: 20% for 99.0–99.98, 50% below 99.0. Requires legal approval for regional failover commitments.

I’ve uploaded the MAP and an editable SOW to a shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/MAP-Acme
And the DocuSign packet for the Pilot Lite: https://docusign.com/hd/1234abcd

If Pilot Lite looks good, we can start with a 3-month pilot and incorporate a performance review at day-45 to consider upgrade to Premium Full.

Best,
Vivek

Attachment: Redwood_Premium_SLA_Proposal_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme.ai
Date: 2027-10-05T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Updated proposal and MAP link — ACME pilot

Thanks Vivek — we reviewed v2 internally. A few points from procurement and engineering:

- Acme prefers the 99.99 guarantee for production-facing models; Pilot Lite is OK for dev traffic but not for prod. Can you scope a production-lite hybrid (99.99 for inference endpoint, 99.95 for control-plane) and how credits would be applied per-component?
- We need written confirmation that named CSM will be available during US night windows (23:00–06:00 ET) and that escalations will be routed to a named on-call engineer during the pilot.
- Procurement asks for a one-time 5% discount on the first quarter as onboarding credit (applied against retainer).

Attaching Acme_Internal_SOW.pdf which outlines their SRO for pilot environment and the specific hours of criticality.

Would appreciate a redlined SOW or an updated DocuSign packet by EOD Thursday if possible.

Best,
Maria

Attachment: Acme_Internal_SOW.pdf (application/pdf)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-06T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Updated proposal and MAP link — ACME pilot

Maria — thanks for the level of detail. We can get to a production-lite hybrid without involving Legal for major changes; summary of our compromise below and next steps.

Compromise proposal (short):
- Componentized uptime: inference endpoints — 99.99% (measured at regional edge), control plane — 99.95%. Credits applied proportionally to impacted component (we calculate credits by weighting token volume to inference vs control-plane calls; methodology included in v3).
- Named CSM + on-call coverage: we will provide a named CSM with guaranteed overlap 23:00–06:00 ET for the pilot period and a named escalation engineer on rotation. That coverage is included in Pilot Premium Full or can be added to Pilot Premium Lite for a $2k/month add-on (50% discount if they sign a 12-month commit).
- Onboarding credit: we’ll accept a one-time 5% credit on the first quarter retainer for Pilot Lite.
- Pricing summary: Pilot Lite (componentized): $5.7k/month after the onboarding credit applied to month 1–3; Pilot Full (prod guarantee): $11k/month. 10% discount with 12-month commit applies to retainer line item.

Next steps: I’ll produce Redwood_Premium_SLA_Proposal_v3.pdf with the componentized credit calculations and a redlined SOW. Karthik — please prepare a MAP (attached MAP-Acme-v1.pdf) and confirm whether Finance can accept the 5% onboarding credit without additional approvals. Laura — can you confirm approval for the named CSM overlap?

If Acme is good with this, I’ll push the DocuSign packet for Pilot Lite v3 and we can kick off onboarding next week.

Regards,
Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP-Acme-v1.pdf (application/pdf)
